injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson (illness) is out for Tuesday's game against Washington, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

injuries.name: P.J. Washington
injuries.detail: Washington (illness) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that Lively (foot) is moving well and progressing in his recovery, and the big man told May he's "close" to returning, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.detail: Lawal (groin) is out for Tuesday's game against Denver.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.detail: Cunningham (knee) is probable for Tuesday's game against the Orlando.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson will be re-evaluated in one week due to a left quadriceps strain, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren (hamstring) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Magic.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.detail: Prince (knee) underwent surgery to address lingering issues and has no timeline for a return, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.detail: Okorie (oblique) won't play Tuesday in Orlando.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.
